description: Example queries; no notification connectors or licensed rules are enabled automatically.

examples.name: Execution refused in the last fifteen minutes
examples.investigation: Correlate event_id and node_id with the Veyport execution detail and current effective policy. No OS identity is implied before preparation.

examples.name: Prepared root execution
examples.investigation: Check actual run_as and actor_person_id; operational admin and prepared root identity are separate facts.

examples.name: Interrupted or uncertain outcome
examples.investigation: Search only proves which records were projected. Check Veyport authoritative process/evidence state and export lag before interpreting absence.

examples.name: Protected original-read activity
examples.investigation: Correlate stable event/correlation IDs with the externally preserved intent and delivery result. Purpose and raw original bytes stay outside search.
